title: Convergence of the rescaled area integrals at a rescaled Lebesgue point of 1_B·J
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel, J : ℝ^n → ℝ Borel and K ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ J(a) ≤ K for all a, m > 0 and b ∈ ℝ^n. Write λ for Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n, 1_B·J := B.indicator J and Λ := DF(b) = fderiv ℝ F b. Assume (i) m|a − b| ≤ |F(a) − F(b)| for all a ∈ B; (ii) F is differentiable at b and Λ is injective; (iii) for every R > 0, ∫_{B̄_R(0)} |1_B(b + rw)·J(b + rw) − J(b)| dλ(w) → 0 as r → 0⁺. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Then ∫_{ℝ^n} 1_B(b + rc)·J(b + rc)·f(r^{-1}(F(b + rc) − F(b))) dλ(c) → J(b)·∫_{ℝ^n} f(Λc) dλ(c) as r → 0⁺.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (K m : ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a ∧ J a ≤ K) → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖F a - F b‖) → DifferentiableAt ℝ F b → Injective (fderiv ℝ F b) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |B.indicator J (b + r • w) - J b|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (J b * ∫ c, f (fderiv ℝ F b c) ∂volume))
